# MMET (IEC 61850-7-4:2007B6), profile default

coverage: 22 measured or mapped, 17 mapped, 5 excluded, 0 unmapped, 20 not measured

## Measurements

MMET.EnvTmp | temperature | unit degC | mmet.envtmp
MMET.WetBlbTmp | temperature | unit degC | mmet.wetblbtmp
MMET.EnvHum | humidity | unit % | mmet.envhum
MMET.DewPt | temperature | unit degC | mmet.dewpt
MMET.DffInsol | irradiance | unit W/m² | mmet.dffinsol
MMET.DctInsol | irradiance | unit W/m² | mmet.dctinsol
MMET.DlDur | duration | unit s | mmet.dldur
MMET.HorInsol | irradiance | unit W/m² | mmet.horinsol
MMET.HorWdDir | direction | unit deg | mmet.horwddir
MMET.HorWdSpd | speed | unit m/s | mmet.horwdspd
MMET.VerWdDir | direction | unit deg | mmet.verwddir
MMET.VerWdSpd | speed | unit m/s | mmet.verwdspd
MMET.WdGustSpd | speed | unit m/s | mmet.wdgustspd
MMET.EnvPres | pressure | unit Pa | mmet.envpres
MMET.SnwDen | density | unit kg/m³ | mmet.snwden
MMET.SnwTmp | temperature | unit degC | mmet.snwtmp
MMET.PoaInsol | irradiance | unit W/m² | mmet.poainsol

## Data objects

EnvTmp MV (MMET): mapped mmet.envtmp
WetBlbTmp MV (MMET): mapped mmet.wetblbtmp
CloudCvr MV (MMET): excluded — cloud cover level whose unit (oktas or percent) the model does not state
EnvHum MV (MMET): mapped mmet.envhum
DewPt MV (MMET): mapped mmet.dewpt
DffInsol MV (MMET): mapped mmet.dffinsol
DctInsol MV (MMET): mapped mmet.dctinsol
DlDur MV (MMET): mapped mmet.dldur
HorInsol MV (MMET): mapped mmet.horinsol
HorWdDir MV (MMET): mapped mmet.horwddir
HorWdSpd MV (MMET): mapped mmet.horwdspd
VerWdDir MV (MMET): mapped mmet.verwddir
VerWdSpd MV (MMET): mapped mmet.verwdspd
WdGustSpd MV (MMET): mapped mmet.wdgustspd
EnvPres MV (MMET): mapped mmet.envpres
RnFll MV (MMET): excluded — rainfall as a depth or a rate; the model states neither
SnwDen MV (MMET): mapped mmet.snwden
SnwTmp MV (MMET): mapped mmet.snwtmp
SnwCvr MV (MMET): excluded — snow cover as a depth or a rate; the model states neither
SnwFll MV (MMET): excluded — snowfall as a depth or a rate; the model states neither
SnwEq MV (MMET): excluded — water equivalent of snowfall as a depth or a rate; the model states neither
PoaInsol MV (MMET): mapped mmet.poainsol
